name: WLAN Monitor
author: uBruckhaus
description: See who is on your Wi-Fi from the bar: every device with a type icon, name, maker and model, your own names for devices, alerts when a new device joins, one click to your router's and devices' web pages, plus signal and live traffic in plain words. Active scans only on networks you trust.

barWidget.description: Devices on your Wi-Fi, router access, signal and traffic
